fields.description: Nothing is sent until this is Active. Use the Start Campaign button rather than editing this by hand.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Lower runs first when several campaigns are due for the same contact.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: The business number this campaign sends from. Every step goes out from here.
fields.label: Send From

fields.description: Sent the moment someone is enrolled. Leave empty to start the sequence silently — use that when the first message went out elsewhere (an MSG91 blast) and this campaign only runs the follow-up.
fields.label: Outreach Template

fields.description: Manual: you add leads by hand. Saved Filter: everyone matching the filter, once, at Start. On Entering State: anyone who reaches the state below, automatically and continuously.
fields.label: Enroll Mode
fields.options:
Manual
Saved Filter
On Entering State

fields.description: Leave blank to begin as soon as the campaign is started.
fields.label: Start On

fields.description: After this, nothing further is sent and open enrollments are closed.
fields.label: End On

fields.description: The audience's timezone. The send window below is read in this zone.
fields.label: Timezone

fields.description: Steps that come due outside this window wait until it opens again.
fields.label: Send Window Start

fields.options: Steps run in order. Each waits its own Wait/Unit after the previous one, then sends unless its condition says otherwise.

fields.description: Stop nudging a contact once they reach one of these states. Opted-out contacts always exit, whether listed here or not.
fields.label: Exit When State Is

fields.description: The moment a rule moves someone into this state, they are enrolled and their first wait begins. Enrolment is one per person per campaign.
fields.label: Enroll When State Becomes

fields.description: Drop anyone whose state ranks above the one that enrolled them, so a person only ever hears the nudge written for the level they are at.
fields.label: Exit When They Reach A Deeper Level

fields.description: Set by Start Campaign. Auto-enrolment ignores anyone whose last message to you predates this, so switching a campaign on never nudges the back catalogue.
fields.label: Started At
